answers.project_description: Hyper-focused desktop environment for JEE/competitive exam preparation with system lockdown and AI mentorship
answers.problem_statement: Students preparing for competitive exams need a zero-distraction environment that enforces study discipline through system-level lockdown and provides intelligent mentorship
answers.target_users: Students preparing for IIT-JEE, NEET, and other competitive exams who require absolute focus
answers.voice_tone: Strict, direct, professional — with macOS-style UI polish
answers.design_principles: Zero Distraction, Recovery-First Engineering, Stealth & Security Integrity, Context Isolation, Agentic AI Integration
answers.tdd_strictness: Moderate — tests encouraged for complex logic
